quest.3BB0926C4C00BE1D.quest_desc:
Don't you hate when you run out of Energy in your Jetpack? Well you'll neever need to worry about that again! 

You might need to make every Jetpack before it, an &6&lATM Star&r, plus more expensive Items but hey it is worth it! 

Just put it on and use it as normal, just with less charging.
quest.3BB0926C4C00BE1D.title: &5&lCreative Jetpack
quest.37D4E5ACB35D8BF1.quest_desc:
The &5&lMekanism&r &cJetpack&r works similar to &l&7Iron Jetpacks&r just with different Modes and it requires Hydrogen as Fuel instead of &aEnergy&r! 

Just place some Hydrogen in the &cJetpack&r by putting it in a &5Machine&r that has Hydrogen. Funny enough the &9&lElectrolytic Separator&r also has Hydrogen when it has &bOxygen&r! 

Once you strap it on your Back you can press (G) to switch between the Modes. 

&4Regular&r: hold Jump to go up, you will move in any direction you hit with WASD and if you don't you will only go up. When you release Jump Button you will Fall. 

&bHover&r: same controls as Default but with slower movement and you won't Fall when you release Jump. You can lower by hitting (Shift). 

&6Vector&r: won't respond to WASD and instead will move to where the Player is looking when holding Jump to go up. 

&4Disabled&r: doesn't work! 

By the way, you can upgrade the &cJetpack&r with a few Blocks and Items to make it have Armor Protection!
quest.32ECD93A8F2FAB8F.quest_desc:
&6Jetpacks&r are a beloved way of getting around. 

To start making them you'll need to start with a &6Wood Jetpack&r! This can be upgraded all the way to a &5Creative Jetpack&r. 

While it does have many versions each work all the same. They all can be placed in your Chestplate Slot, or Back Curio, or Curio Curio. 

All of them also need FE to work, you can use any Item Charger to charge them! They will use FE to fly and yes you will drop if you run out of Energy. 
To fly you'll need to turn on your Engine (V), then when you hold Space you'll fly up and drop when you let go. 

For those who don't enjoy dropping, then you can turn on Hover (Unbinded), when set on you will Fly at the same altitude; being able to go higher with (Space) and lower with (Shift). 

To adjust how fast you fly, change your Throttle. Decreasing it is (,) by default and increasing it is (.) by default!
quest.32ECD93A8F2FAB8F.title: &l&6Iron Jetpacks
quest.378C95C18798D413.quest_desc: A quick way to switch between tools.\n\nUpgrade with belt pouches in an anvil to increase capacity.

quest.3B4BF42C55C8BBBF.quest_desc:
Don't you hate when your breaking something and the Blocks fall just out of your reach! 

Well worry no more for we have &4Magnets&r! Simply Right Click while holding the &4Magnet&r to turn it on. Then, all dropped Items and Blocks in a 5 Block Radius will come to you. 

You can also equip the &4Magnet&r in your Curios to keep using it! 

If you don't wish to continue using the &4Magnet&r (I find this happens near Mob Farms) then just Right Click with it again to disable it. You can also place Demagnetization Coils at your Mob Farms and other factories that involve dropped items to prevent this.

It can also be upgraded to increase the range!
quest.3B4BF42C55C8BBBF.title: &l&9Simple &4Magnets
